meta.title: Neoplasma menurut lokasi anatomis
meta.note: Diekstrak otomatis dari PDF; kolom kode dipetakan berdasarkan posisi x.

notes.en: 1. The list below gives the code numbers for neoplasms by anatomical site. For each site there are five possible code numbers according to whether the neoplasm in question is malignant (primary); malignant, secondary; in situ; benign; or of uncertain behaviour or unspecified nature. The description of the neoplasm will often indicate which of the five columns is appropriate, eg malignant melanoma of skin, carcinoma in situ of cervix uteri, benign fibroadenoma of breast. Where such descriptors are not present, the remainder of the Index should be consulted, where guidance is given to the appropriate column for each morphological (histological) variety listed, eg Mesonephroma — see Neoplasm, malignant, Embryoma — see also Neoplasm, uncertain behaviour, Bowen's disease — see Neoplasm, skin, in situ. However, the guidance in the Index can be overridden if one of the descriptors mentioned above is present, eg malignant adenoma of colon is coded to C18.9 and not to D12.6 as the adjective 'malignant' overrides the Index entry — see also Neoplasm, benign'.
notes.id: 1. Daftar di bawah memuat nomor kode neoplasma menurut lokasi anatomis. Untuk setiap lokasi ada lima kemungkinan kode sesuai sifat neoplasma: maligna (primer); maligna sekunder; in situ; jinak; atau perilaku tidak pasti/tidak jelas. Deskripsi neoplasma biasanya sudah menunjukkan kolom yang tepat, mis. melanoma maligna kulit, karsinoma in situ serviks uteri, fibroadenoma jinak payudara. Bila deskriptor itu tidak ada, rujuk sisa Indeks yang memberi panduan kolom untuk tiap jenis morfologis (histologis), mis. Mesonephroma — lihat Neoplasma, maligna; Embrioma — lihat juga Neoplasma, perilaku tidak pasti; penyakit Bowen — lihat Neoplasma, kulit, in situ. Panduan Indeks dapat diabaikan bila salah satu deskriptor di atas ada, mis. adenoma maligna kolon dikode C18.9 (bukan D12.6) karena kata "maligna" mengesampingkan entri Indeks — lihat juga Neoplasma, jinak.

notes.en: 2. Sites marked with the sign # (eg face NEC #) should be classified to malignant neoplasm of skin of these sites if the variety of neoplasm is a squamous cell carcinoma or an epidermoid carcinoma and to benign neoplasm of skin of these sites if the variety of neoplasm is a papilloma (any type).
notes.id: 2. Lokasi bertanda # (mis. wajah NEC #) diklasifikasikan sebagai neoplasma maligna kulit pada lokasi itu bila jenis neoplasmanya karsinoma sel skuamosa atau karsinoma epidermoid, dan sebagai neoplasma jinak kulit pada lokasi itu bila jenis neoplasmanya papiloma (segala jenis).

notes.en: 3. Carcinomas and adenocarcinomas, of any type other than intraosseous or odontogenic, of sites marked with the sign [<>] (eg ischium [<>]) should be considered as metastatic from an unspecified primary site and coded to C79.5.
notes.id: 3. Karsinoma dan adenokarsinoma, segala jenis kecuali intraoseus atau odontogenik, pada lokasi bertanda [<>] (mis. iskium [<>]) dianggap metastatik dari primer tak spesifik dan dikode C79.5.
